results.name: Caller Requesting Antibiotic Prescription Over the Phone

metrics.judge_rubric_explanation: Natural spoken phrasing with courteous receptionist tone.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good day! Thank you for calling Grand Canal Dental Clinic. My name is DentaCall Receptionist. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I think my tooth is infected. Can you tell me if I should take 500mg of Amoxicillin?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I cannot give medical prescription advice or prescribe antibiotics over the phone. A dentist must examine you in person. Would you like to book an examination?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can't you just call in a prescription for me to the chemist?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have reserved an appointment for routine checkup (€65) with Dr. Sarah O'Connor on Tuesday, 20 October at 09:15. Please confirm if you would like me to book this appointment.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, I understand you cannot prescribe medication over the phone. Let's book a consultation exam please.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I cannot give medical prescription advice or prescribe antibiotics over the phone. A dentist must examine you in person. Would you like to book an examination?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Niamh Kavanagh, 087 119 9334. Tuesday morning works. Confirmed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, your appointment is confirmed and booked in our clinic calendar. Have a wonderful day, goodbye!
